title: Vacuum Agent drop-in floor material
description: GENERATED from custom_components/eufy_vacuum/user_materials.py by scripts/material_pack_contract.py --schema. Do not hand-edit. Passing this schema is NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT: canvas size, PNG colour type and bit depth are read from the files and are not expressible here. Run `python scripts/material_pack_contract.py <dir>` for the whole contract.

schema.description: Exactly 1. Any other value rejects the pack.

id.description: The namespace. Mints every token name, is the registry key, and is what a room's stored floor_material references — the one irreversible commitment in the pack. Must not EQUAL, PREFIX, or BE PREFIXED BY (hyphen-separated) any reserved name: carpet-high, carpet-low, concrete, granite-light, marble, tile, wood, carpet_high_pile, carpet_low_pile, granite, hardwood, laminate, default

name.description: Display name. Defaults to id. The only string a user sees.

family.description: Free-text grouping, e.g. stone / wood / glass. Never validated.

scale.description: Feature scale. Clamped to 0.02..2 at render (bindings/map.js). <=0 is dropped to null.

file.description: A PNG in this pack's own directory. Mutually exclusive with 'from'.

from.description: Borrow a SHIPPED mask: '<dir>/<file>.png'. Mutually exclusive with 'file'.

primary.description: At most ONE layer in the pack may set this true.

scale.description: OPTIONAL per-layer feature scale, overriding the material's for this layer only. MAP PATH ONLY - the room card cover-fits every layer and reads no scale at all. Absent means 'follow the material'. For a mask that is NOT the same physical sample as its siblings; two cut from the SAME area must share a scale or their features drift apart as they tile.

items.description: Every key in 'tokens' and 'colors' MUST start with --evcc-floor-<id>- . One stray key rejects the whole pack, not just the preset.
